ayahs.text_digital_khatt: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءࣲ قَدِيرٌ ۝١
ayahs.translation_sahih: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
ayahs.translation_phrased: Blessed is He in whose hand is the dominion, and He is capable of all things.

ayahs.translation_sahih: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
ayahs.translation_phrased: The One who created death and life to test you as to which of you is best in deed, and He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

clauses.translation: The One who created death and life
to test you as to which of you is best in deed,
and He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.

ayahs.translation_sahih: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
ayahs.translation_phrased: The One who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return your vision. Do you see any breaks?

clauses.translation: The One who created seven heavens in layers.

clauses.text: مَّا تَرَىٰ فِي خَلۡقِ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٖۖ
clauses.translation: You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency.

ayahs.translation_sahih: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
ayahs.translation_phrased: Then return your vision twice more. Your vision will return to you humbled, and it is exhausted.

clauses.translation: Then return your vision twice more.

ayahs.translation_sahih: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

ayahs.translation_sahih: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

ayahs.translation_sahih: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

clauses.translation: So they admit their sin;

ayahs.translation_sahih: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.translation_phrased: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and a great reward.

clauses.translation: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen

ayahs.translation_sahih: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

ayahs.translation_sahih: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?
ayahs.translation_phrased: Would the One who created not know? And He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

clauses.translation: Would the One who created not know?

phrases.translation: Would the One who created not know?

clauses.translation: And He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

clauses.text: فَسَتَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ هُوَ فِي ضَلَٰلٖ مُّبِينٖ
clauses.translation: So you will soon know who it is that is in clear error.”

ayahs.text_digital_khatt: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرࣰا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءࣲ مَّعِينِۭ ۝٣٠
ayahs.translation_sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
ayahs.translation_phrased: Say, “Have you considered: if your water were to sink away, who then could bring you flowing water?”

clauses.translation: Say, “Have you considered:
if your water were to sink away,

phrases.translation: your water were to sink away,

clauses.translation: who then could bring you flowing water?”
